name: reference-for-zotero

scripts.format:check: prettier --check "src/**/*.ts" "test/**/*.{ts,json}" "typings/**/*.d.ts" "addon/**/*.{js,json,md}" "docs/**/*.md" AGENTS.md eslint.config.js README.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md PRIVACY.md SECURITY.md package.json tsconfig.json zotero-plugin.config.ts

scripts.verify:artifact: npm run build && npm run audit:scansci-xpi
